first_hop_receiver.description: First-hop receiver — used verbatim as the outbound MsgTransfer `receiver`. Typically a Noble address (`noble1...`).

forward_memo.description: JSON memo carrying PFM / CCTP forwarding instructions. Inserted verbatim into the outbound MsgTransfer's `memo` field.

ibc_channel.description: Outbound IBC channel on Zigchain (e.g. "channel-0", typically to Noble).
